style: Flat editorial illustration, soft shadows, calm and clinical-neutral. Palette: deep green #1A7A52, mint #E6F4EC, warm grey #E5E5E5 accents. Wide 3:2 composition with generous empty space at the edges. No text, letters, numbers, logos or brand names. No photographs of real people, no identifiable faces, no crisis or distress imagery.

items.scene: A quiet workspace with an open notebook, a mug of tea and a laptop showing an abstract calm chat bubble, sunlight through a window onto a plant.
items.alt: Open notebook, tea and laptop on a desk by a window, a calm setting for starting online therapy
